---
name: Feature request
about: Propose a new capability or design change
labels: enhancement
---

## Problem

What user or engineering problem should be solved?

## Proposed behavior

Describe the desired behavior without assuming a specific implementation unless necessary.

## Interoperability

List relevant formats, standards, APIs, or external tools.

## Licensing / dependencies

Would this require new third-party code, binaries, datasets, standards text, or a change to the Community/Enterprise boundary?

## Verification

How could the project demonstrate that the feature works correctly?
